# Level 2: Distributable Wheel (.whl) Package Build & Verification

## 1. Overview & Objective

**Level 2 Testing** evaluates the standalone distributable artifacts (`.whl` and `.tar.gz`) generated by `uv build`.

### The Core Hypothesis
> *`uv build` will package all required source modules (`app`, `app.core`, `app.mcp`, `app.cli`) and entrypoints into a standalone `.whl` archive while strictly excluding runtime directories (`playwright_profile/`) and development tests. Installing this `.whl` directly via `uv tool install` simulates an end-user installing the package from PyPI or a private artifact registry.*

---

## 4. Wheel Installation & Overwrite Verification

### Installation Command
```powershell
$wheel = Get-ChildItem .\dist\*.whl | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
uv tool install --force $wheel
```

### Raw Installation Log:
```text
Resolved 62 packages in 2.68s
Prepared 1 package in 87ms
Installed 62 packages in 3.27s
...
 + contextportal-backend==0.1.0 (from file:///C:/Users/maruthi.n.marella/ContextPortal/backend/dist/contextportal_backend-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl)
...
Installed 1 executable: contextportal
```

### Key Observation: Source Install vs Wheel Install
- In **Level 1 (Source install)**, the package origin was:
  `from file:///C:/Users/maruthi.n.marella/ContextPortal/backend`
- In **Level 2 (Wheel install)**, the package origin was:
  `from file:///C:/Users/maruthi.n.marella/ContextPortal/backend/dist/contextportal_backend-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`

## 6. Level 2 Test Verdict

| Check | Expected Result | Actual Result | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wheel Build (`uv build`) | Generate `.whl` and `.tar.gz` with clean subpackage structure | Created 10.1 KB `.whl` including `app.core`, `app.mcp`, `app.cli` | ✅ **PASS** |
| Session Privacy Audit | Exclude `playwright_profile/` from `.whl` | Zero cookies or credentials present in archive | ✅ **PASS** |
| Wheel Tool Install | `uv tool install --force $wheel` overwrites source install | Verified via `uv tool list` and install origin | ✅ **PASS** |
| Wheel Public Retrieval | Fetch public URL from `$env:TEMP` | Returned Markdown via HTTP | ✅ **PASS** |
| Wheel Protected Retrieval | Fetch protected URL from `$env:TEMP` using global profile | Returned Markdown with `Authenticated: True` | ✅ **PASS** |

**Overall Level 2 Status**: 🚀 **STANDALONE WHEEL VERIFIED & READY FOR DISTRIBUTION**
